title: Training Notes: Comfort Club Members and the Cancellation Administrative Fee on Labor-Only Protection
content:
**What does a member pay as the administrative fee when cancelling?**
On a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the administrative fee charged on a cancellation is the tier's cancellation administrative fee times the member admin-fee share. The share is set by the holder's Comfort Club agreement in active status on the date of confirmation, read from the holder's Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements record.

| Holder's Comfort Club agreement on the date of confirmation | Member admin-fee share |
|---|---|
| in active status, held for three or more consecutive terms | 0.00 |
| in active status, held for fewer than three consecutive terms | 0.50 |
| no agreement in active status | 1 |

**Where is the line?** Three consecutive terms take 0.00; two take 0.50.

**Does the Comfort Club tier matter?** No. Only active status and the number of consecutive terms are read.

**Example (hypothetical, administrative fee $50.00 used for illustration).** Holder in the second consecutive term of an active agreement: $50.00 times 0.50 is $25.00. Holder in the fifth consecutive term: $0.00. Holder whose agreement was cancelled last year: $50.00.
